notes.title: You asked for changes-here they are 😽
notes.notes:
All right you furry-loving beasts out there 🐯🦊🦁🐺
As promised, here is a new update to our game. We hope to address some of your worries with our game and hope you will enjoy the experience even more now.



[b]Easy/Hard Mode:[/b]
We created this game originally with 40 cards (20 pairs) to discover each round. After we heard your feedback, we understood that we put the challenge before the casual game experience. So we adjusted it. 

- The Normal Mode features now 20 cards instead of 40
- "Getting Hard Mode" was added with the original 40 cards
- Hard Mode grants additional points



[b]Adjustment to point system:[/b]
We also addressed the feedback that a round won't grant enough points, so we adjusted the difficulty.

- Highest Streak Bonus adjusted (100 / 200 / 300 / 400/ 500 ...)
- the discovery of pairs grants now 20 points instead of 10
- the Streak Bonus was adjusted  -> 30 / 50 / 150 / 300 / 350
- Time Bonus was removed
- Points to unlock gallery images were adjusted

[b]Adjustment to the dialogue system:[/b]
- "Need help? " Dialogue is triggering now after 7 fails, not after 5


[b]Sounds:[/b]
-Added extra juicy sounds when checking a box

Rawr!

notes.title: We heard your feedback 🫦
notes.notes:
[h3]Alright you horny furry lovers, we got your feedback.
[/h3]

Since release some people told us that we might have made our little sexy-casual-play with one hand-furry-game a bit too challenging to enjoy the core of what "Furry Seduction" should be about ...💦

[b]So we got news![/b]
We are working on a new mode to enjoy our game more casually and have a content update coming soon.

With the next patch, we will bring in a "getting hard mode" *wink*
and our new standard mode will be easier, more casual, and more accessible.
So you can enjoy our furry ladies without breaking your head too much.

Furthermore, we are happy to announce a content update with a new exclusive Artwork from our in-house artist "Haseth".

"But when is it coming out, how long must I suffer to see the new features and sexy artwork??" You might be asking.
-Soon. Like... really soon, if the steam gods bless us with easy uploads. 🤞

Until then, enjoy another round and get excited
